Historia di don Ferdinando Cortes (Historia de Mexico) (Francisco López de Gómara, 1552)
==========================================================
Gómara's Historia de Mexico (1552) - Cortés's chaplain-historian's official life of the conquest; the narrative Bernal Díaz wrote to correct. No PD English translation exists; the 1560 Venetian Italian translation, staged as a PD documentary text.
